name: Libbey 12 oz. Clear Stemmed Wine Glasses Set of 4
description: Selling a matching set of four classic Libbey-style 12 oz. stemmed wine glasses. Crystal clear with an elegant classic bowl shape, these are ideal for everyday white or red wine dining, student apartment setups, or hosting small home parties. The glasses are in great condition with no chips, cracks, or heavy scratches. Coming from a pet-friendly home with a cat; every single glass has been thoroughly deep hand-washed, polished with fiber cloths, and sanitized prior to listing.
contact_note: Fully pre-assembled tableware. Does NOT come with an additional fabric or cloth storage cover bag. Fragile glass items—local pickup buyers are highly recommended to bring a small box or padded tote with towels/paper to wrap them securely for the car ride home. Comes from a cat-friendly home, fully hand-washed and sanitized with alcohol wipes. Distance-tiered pricing is kept tightly flat!
meta_description: Set of 4 classic clear stemmed wine glasses by Libbey in good condition. No chips or cracks, fully hand-washed and sanitized for local apartment pickup.
name_zh: Libbey 经典高脚红白葡萄酒杯 4件套
